claim: New York City has as many students in its district schools as Colorado has in all its public schools
caveat_shown: Counting the city's roughly 150,000 charter pupils and its pre-K would put New York City ahead of Colorado rather than behind it.

claim: New York City has as many people on the city payroll as Texas has state employees
caveat_shown: Both are actual full-time headcounts. The federal survey reflects a March 2025 payroll.

claim: New York City houses as many people in public housing and its converted successors as live in Cleveland
caveat_shown: Public housing proper holds 298,206 authorised residents; another 46,455 live in developments converted to private management under PACT, which the housing authority no longer counts as public housing.

claim: New York City shelters as many homeless people each night as Andorra has people
caveat_shown: Department of Homeless Services shelters only; other agencies' shelters and migrant sites are not included.

claim: New York City has as many college students as all of Massachusetts
caveat_shown: Massachusetts is fall 2022, the latest year in the federal table; New York City's is a 2024 count.

claim: New York City employs as many public school teachers as all of Ireland
caveat_shown: Ireland's count is from 2022, the most recent its education department publishes, and it was then rising by about 2,000 a year, so Ireland has probably passed New York City since.

claim: New York City has as many people on Medicaid as all of Florida
caveat_shown: New York City's month is July 2026, Florida's April 2026.

claim: New York City has as many residents with a disability as Virginia
caveat_shown: Civilian, non-institutional population on both sides.

claim: New York City proposes to spend as much on its police department as Iraq spends on its military
caveat_shown: Executive Plan figure for fiscal 2027, not the adopted line.

claim: New York City proposes to spend as much on public schools as Iceland produces in a year
New York City takes in as much visitor spending as Tunisia's entire economy
